Hi Jordan / ClearWave team,

Thanks for agreeing to move forward with Redwood for the logistics tooling pilot. To get finance and procurement to create a vendor record and enable PO issuance, we need the buyer intake + banking paperwork completed. I attached our onboarding worksheet (vendor_onboarding_form_v2.pdf) — please complete the highlighted sections and return the items below so we can queue accounting for activation.

Required items (please send as PDF or scanned images):
- Legal entity full name as registered (exact payee name)
- W-9 (or W-8 BEN for non-US entities) signed by authorized signer
- Remit-to postal address (for PO and physical invoices)
- ACH details: bank name, account holder name, routing number, account number, copy of bank letter or voided check
- Tax ID / EIN (confirm format and issuing state)
- Payment terms (confirm Net 30 / PO requirement / early-pay discounts if any)
- Buyer contact for PO communications (name, email, phone)
- DUNS or LEI (if you have one) and correct legal address for tax mapping
- Beneficial ownership information (required for finance KYC if >25% owners)

Optional but helpful:
- Sample invoice that includes the PO number field you expect
- Any vendor portal access docs (if ClearWave controls invoicing)

A couple of notes on our side so you know what triggers vendor activation:
- Invoices must include the Redwood PO number to be paid; we will not process non-PO invoices without exception approvals.
- If payee name on W-9 and bank account do not match, we need a bank letter showing DBA/alias or a vendor affidavit.
- ACH activation typically takes 5–7 business days after we receive all docs.

Please send items to this thread. If you can return everything by EOD next Tuesday (2026-09-01), we will aim to have your vendor code and first PO created by 2026-09-08.

Thanks,
